items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, she was a good singer.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, on a record, I think.

Yeah, she was a good singer. She must have been related to Earl at one time, wasn't she? I think so. Well, her uncle and aunt was the one that had this show, Rock Dinah (?), that I was on when we went down there. And they had a number by a guy named Johnny Bagsley(?), who wore his hair slick, straight, you know, and they were doing various... He wore.... This number, "If I Could Be With You One Hour Tonight." And he had the smoking jacket on, and she had the negligee on, and they had this screen up between them…

By the way, this was... See, we played like in a pit(?) one part of the night, and then the next part we went to a place called "Trees". That's enough time to get from one theatre to the other and set up, you know. And what they did to keep us from playing in the pit, everybody came with either a bucket of ashes or water, so we couldn't sit in the pit, you know. You awake?
